# B309 Next Step Plan
Дата: 13.09.2026

## Priority 1 — final action distribution
Measure how verified policy learning changes the *whole-organism* action distribution over a long sequence. Compare baseline, trained, and policy-lesioned conditions.

## Priority 2 — remaining arbitration overlap
Use B309 redundancy diagnostics on live traces to identify the specific source families that still drown the policy signal. Merge or route duplicate branches before changing coefficients.

## Priority 3 — Android/Termux
Run the existing B305 Termux benchmark on the target Android device. Capture real RAM, CPU, latency, thermal and battery evidence.

## Priority 4 — verification debt
Generate direct VERIFIED tests for the critical arbitration edges first, not random peripheral functions.

## Non-goal
Do not create another generic learner, personality store, replay store, or parallel executive. Reuse B296/B297/B299/B302/B304/B305/B306/B308 state and evidence.

## Post-B310 disposition
B310 has partially resolved the action-surface problem: policy signals now reach the recorded final candidate surface and policy lesion changes the whole-organism distribution. Natural learning-induced distribution change remains unresolved and is carried into B311 as a controlled benchmark target.
